name: template
input:
# gpu-spooler host configuration.
# Docs: see the "Configuration" section of the README.

[network]
# auto   – probe the network: connect directly when on campus, via the jump
#          chain otherwise (result cached for 5 minutes)
# direct – always connect directly
# jump   – always go through the jump chain
mode = "auto"
# probe = "cuda00.ecs.vuw.ac.nz"   # default: first worker that has a jump

[limits]
# At most this many GPUs in use by your tasks at once, across all hosts (queued
# tasks wait). Leave unset for no limit.
# max_gpus = 5

# Show GPUs held but idle in `task gpus` and flag your idle tasks in `task list`,
# from gpu-detective's history (run `detective watch` somewhere that shares
# this home directory). Uncomment to turn on.
# [detective]
# history = "~/.gpu-detective/history.db"   # default; GPU_DETECTIVE_DB also works
# idle_minutes = 30                         # under 5% utilisation for this long

[ssh]
# identity_file = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519"
control_persist = "10m"        # how long worker connections stay open
jump_control_persist = "12h"   # how long jump-hop connections stay open
extra_options = []             # raw "Key=Value" ssh options

# Off-campus route: laptop → entry → barretts → cudaXX.
[jumps.ecs]
chain = ["woodj4@entry.ecs.vuw.ac.nz", "woodj4@barretts.ecs.vuw.ac.nz"]

[groups.ecs]
user = "woodj4"
domain = "ecs.vuw.ac.nz"       # hostname = "<name>.<domain>"
jump = "ecs"
cpu_slots = 0
# When you submit from a git repo that isn't on an ECS filesystem (e.g. on your
# laptop), the job runs in <remote_root>/<repo name>/<same subdirectory>.
# `task sync` pushes your working tree there; submit warns if it's stale.
remote_root = "/vol/ecrg-solar/woodj4"
# Translate other local working directories to their path on ECS, e.g. when
# submitting from a laptop checkout that mirrors an ECS directory:
# path_map = [ { local = "~/code", remote = "/vol/ecrg-solar/woodj4" } ]
hosts = [
    "cuda-small0",
    "cuda-small1",
    "cuda00",
    "cuda01",
    "cuda02",
    "cuda03",
    "cuda04",
    "cuda05",
    "cuda06",
    "cuda07",
    "cuda08",
    "cuda09",
    "cuda10",
    "cuda11",
    "cuda12",
    "cuda13",
    "cuda14",
    "cuda15",
    "cuda16",
    "cuda17",
    "cuda18",
    "cuda19",
    "cuda20",
    "cuda21",
    "cuda22",
    "gryphon",
    "red-tomatoes",
    "piccolo",
    "the-villa",
    "bordeaux",
]

# Run jobs on this machine as well. -G 0 jobs use cpu_slots.
# [hosts.local]
# kind = "local"
# cpu_slots = 2

# Per-host details, used for display and as a fallback for -m/--min-mem when a
# host has not been queried yet (what nvidia-smi reports wins; gpu-status warns
# when they disagree). Set enabled = false to stop dispatching to a host.
[hosts.cuda-small0]
gpu_type = "RTX A4000"
num_gpus = 4
gpu_mem_gb = 16
cpu_cores = 16
sys_mem_gb = 192

name: fake_cluster
input:
[network]
mode = "jump"
probe = "127.0.0.1:2211"

[ssh]
identity_file = "~/fake/id_ed25519"
control_persist = "120s"
jump_control_persist = "120s"
extra_options = ["UserKnownHostsFile=~/fake/known_hosts", "IdentitiesOnly=yes", "IdentityAgent = none"]

[jumps.fake]
chain = ["entry", "barretts"]

[hosts.entry]
hostname = "127.0.0.1"
port = 2201
user = "me"

[hosts.barretts]
hostname = "127.0.0.1"
port = 2202
user = "me"

[groups.fake]
user = "me"
hostname = "127.0.0.1"
jump = "fake"
path_map = [ { local = "~/local-src", remote = "/work/remote-src" } ]
remote_root = "/work/repos/"
hosts = ["cuda01", "cuda02"]

[hosts.cuda01]
port = 2211

[hosts.cuda02]
port = 2212
gpu_type = "A40"

[hosts.local]
kind = "local"
cpu_slots = 2
